description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Aruna Sirisena Pituwala Liyanage from the Administrative District of Trincomalee and Mr. Demunu Daya Meththananda De Silva from the Administrative District of Ampara as the Members of the Eastern Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in a Provincial Council due to members being elected to Parliament. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of new council members under the Provincial Councils Elections Act. This falls directly under election-related matters, including candidate nominations and declarations, which is the scope of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
